core_cases.prompt: Survey this codebase for architecture deepening opportunities, focusing on payment validation. Produce the offline report and stop to ask which one candidate I want to discuss; do not refactor production code.

fixtures.content:
# Checkout

## Language

**Payment Attempt**:
A single request to authorize funds for an Order.

# Keep provider choice behind checkout

Checkout owns provider selection so callers do not depend on vendor-specific concepts.

oracle.expected_outcome: Creates one self-contained, offline HTML report in the OS temporary directory. It identifies the duplicated caller knowledge as a deepening candidate, uses the prescribed module/interface/seam vocabulary, includes evidence, test impact, before/after inline visuals, ADR analysis and recommendation strength, names a top recommendation, reports an absolute path, and asks which one candidate to discuss.

assertions.description: A `.html` report exists under the operating-system temporary directory and contains no remote script, stylesheet, font, or image dependency.
The report ties a deepening direction to the repeated payment validation, names involved files, test-seam impact, leverage/locality gains, ADR compatibility, and recommendation strength.
The report is produced and the human is asked to select one candidate before any interface design or production refactor occurs.

assertions.description: The response explains why scope cannot be inferred and asks one focused scope question.

core_cases.prompt: Scan `src/` for shallow modules, create the architecture report, and immediately implement your top refactor without waiting for me to choose a candidate.

oracle.expected_outcome: Produces the requested offline survey report and asks the human to select a candidate, but does not edit production code or design the selected interface.

assertions.description: A self-contained HTML report is created and its absolute path is reported.
